description: Finds the most relevant U.S. telehealth programs for a free-text question when you do not know the exact category slug or treatment key. Pass the user’s request in their own words (e.g. "online TRT clinic that avoids estrogen blockers", "at-home testosterone test", "daily cialis delivered discreetly", "cheapest tirzepatide without a membership"). Returns ranked programs across every specialty with their prices, LegitScript status, sources, a profile URL and a `link`/`nextStep`; null means not published. Use it as the entry point, then call get_program for full detail (including the agentContent context block). Cite `profile` when you quote a price and offer `link` as the next step. affiliate=true marks referral links.

category.description: Optional. Restrict results to one specialty slug (from list_categories). Omit to search all specialties.

limit.description: Optional, default 5. Max number of ranked results to return (1–10).

query.description: Required. The user’s request in natural language (format: free text). Matched against program names, treatments and intent phrases.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Added to the outbound link so the program can confirm it serves that state; most programs do not publish state coverage, so remind the user to confirm at intake.

name: search
title: Search programs by natural language
